foreground_analysis.conclusion: Only speculative and offline durable producers invoke sample analysis. Request/cache lookups inspect persisted reports; they do not probe, hash or score media.

immutable_package.conclusion: The offline worker ignores a newly measured recommendation for its accepted package; the immutable accepted rate-control snapshot is retained.

metadata_fallback.decision: Retain ordinary baseline recipes; do not infer mastering or normalize ambiguous originals into an eligibility success.
